t.zh: 把自然数的声明交给<part-ref to="lemma:elimGen"></part-ref>，看它生成什么，再和声明给出的归纳法比一比。
t.en: Hand the declaration of the numbers to the <part-ref to="lemma:elimGen"></part-ref>, see what it makes, and compare it with the induction the declaration gives.

after.zh: 生成器给出的只是按情况分，少了归纳假设：要生成归纳规则，得先认出哪条引入规则要的正是声明的那种东西。
after.en: The generator gives only cases, without the induction hypothesis: to make the induction rule, it must first see which introduction rule takes the very kind of thing being declared.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：生成自然数的消去规则。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that makes the elimination rule of the numbers.

hint.zh: 生成器已经在元件箱里。
hint.en: The generator is already in the parts box.
